title: AWS Lambda to Amazon SNS
description: Create a Lambda function that publishes to an SNS topic

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys an SNS topic and a Lambda function that will send a custom message to the topic once triggered. The CDK application contains the minimum IAM resources required to run the application.
